text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 38 A Thelma Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where on-street permit parking is authorised on an opposite side basis with less than 90 percent subscription. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Denied the request for front yard parking at 38 A Thelma Avenue.
